title: Two screens and navigation
summary: An app with two screens: one button to go there, one to come back.
done: Stack navigation holds no secrets for you: “go to screen” pushes, “go back” pops, and the previous screen keeps its state.

welcome.text: Real apps have several screens. Let’s link two of them: one button to go to the second, another to come back.

next-button.text: On the **{{screen.1}}** screen, add a **Button** and write “Next” in its text.

add-screen.text: Open the screen picker and choose **Add a screen**.

back-button.text: You are now on **{{screen.2}}**. Give it a “Back” **Button**.

go-blocks.text: Open the **Blocks** tab: we stay on {{screen.2}}.

back-block.text: Add [when {{Button.2}} is clicked] and, from **Screens**, [go back to the previous screen] inside it.

switch-screen.text: Switch to the **{{screen.1}}** screen with the screen picker.

open-block.text: Add [when {{Button}} is clicked] and, inside it, [go to screen {{screen.2}}].

go-there.text: In the preview, tap **Next**: the app moves to {{screen.2}}.
